horizontal_tail.name: Horizontal tail spar
horizontal_tail.model: Timoshenko beam FEA, 2 DOF/node, 21 sizing stations + Saint-Venant root-warping stress recovery
assumptions: Same solver and stations as the contract FeaResult; optimisation scales t_f and t_w linearly root→tip
Gauges clamped to Raymer minimums t_f ≥ 2.0 mm, t_w ≥ 1.5 mm
Mass is one tail half (multiply by 2)
Tail load case and planform from the tail sizing: Raymer 2ed Eqs. 14.12-14.13, C_n (p. 347), Table 4.3
horizontal_tail.convergence_note: Stations fixed by the spar sizing (21 nodes).

metrics.governing: outer cap fibre at y = 0.00 m

ai_proposal.rationale: The baseline horizontal tail spar has a generous 0.91 margin governed by root cap bending and Saint-Venant warping at y = 0.00 m, with stress dropping rapidly toward the tip. Scaling both root and tip gauges near the 0.60 lower bound minimizes mass while preserving a safety margin above 0.10.

min_mass.rationale: The baseline horizontal tail spar has a generous 0.91 margin governed by root cap bending and Saint-Venant warping at y = 0.00 m, with stress dropping rapidly toward the tip. Scaling both root and tip gauges near the 0.60 lower bound minimizes mass while preserving a safety margin above 0.10.

ai_proposal.rationale: Bending moment and shear peak at the root attachment while the outboard region is lightly loaded. Shifting structural mass from the tip (k_tip = 0.60) to reinforce the governing root cap and web (k_root = 1.22) maximizes the stress margin without exceeding baseline mass.

max_margin.rationale: Grid search over 169 solver runs; highest margin at no added mass (material moved toward the governing zone). Root cap and web gauge ×1.00, tip cap and web gauge ×1.00: mass +0.00 kg, peak σ_vM 177 → 177 MPa, margin +0.91 → +0.91. Governing: outer cap fibre at y = 0.00 m.

ai_proposal.rationale: To minimize peak von Mises stress at the governing y = 0.00 m root station, tip gauge is reduced to the 0.60 minimum and the 5% allowable mass increase is concentrated into thickening the root cap and web (k_root = 1.30).
